[SHEET 02.C] · LIMIT

A pattern, or a filter artifact?

The overview lists four reasons to doubt the waves are real clocks:

  • Slutsky–Yule effect: trend filters such as moving averages and Hodrick–Prescott can manufacture 40–60-year periodicities out of raw series.
  • Unit roots: macro series follow stochastic trends, so shocks leave permanent marks instead of reverting to a fifty-year sine wave.
  • Exogenous shocks: Trotsky and Mandel argued that wars and conquests, not endogenous rhythm, drive long swings.
  • Smooth growth: Solow treats technological progress as continuous, with no wave periodicity to explain.

Your files date the waves three different ways, and the disagreement is largest at the wave we are living through. That is the model’s weak point and its most useful warning. It fits the revised thesis: cycles are lenses, not clocks. [REV 1 · OPEN]
